_doc: The Timbermaw Tunnel's quests and the Deadwood feather turn-in. Written by tools/build_timbermaw_hold.py.

quests.title: The Tunnel Opens
quests.description: Warden Bramblecoat keeps the Timbermaw Tunnel's south mouth. Thornclaw promised you'd be the first outsider up the hill once the Elders opened it, and the Elders want to meet you.

objectives.label: Bring Bramblecoat's token to Elder Haldor Mossmane at the Great Lodge in Timbermaw Hold

quests.accept_text:
Thornclaw said you'd be the first one up the hill, and he was right. Three years that mouth has been shut, and you're the first outsider through it.

Take this token so the others know I let you in. Climb past the waystation and through the Honey Galleries, then keep on along the passage past them all the way to its end. That's the door to Timbermaw Hold, our home. Elder Haldor's at the Great Lodge at the top of the Hold, and he wants to see who Thornclaw's been talking about.
quests.turn_in_text:
So you're Thornclaw's outsider. Welcome to Timbermaw Hold.

Not many outsiders have come this far, and the ones who did usually came to steal honey. Look round as long as you like. When you want work, Pathfinder Grosk in the tunnel's Lower Galleries has been watching Felpaw for me, and he'll tell you what needs doing.

on_accept.name: Bramblecoat's Token
on_accept.description: A carved wooden bear's head on a cord. The Timbermaw know whose it is.

quests.title: The Shamans Who Turned
quests.description: Kill the Deadwood Shamans of Felpaw Village for Pathfinder Grosk.
quests.accept_text:
The Elder sent you to me, so you've seen the Hold. The Deadwood were Timbermaw once, and some of them were born up there. The fel got into them through the water, but it's their shamans who keep it in them. Every night they feed the fel to the rest, and every night the rest forget a little more of who they were.

Go down the tunnel to North Felwood and south-east to Felpaw Village, and put the shamans down. I'm not asking you to enjoy it, because I don't.
quests.turn_in_text:
The drums stopped last night. Selva heard it from the spring before the wardens did.

Without their shamans, some of the Deadwood might remember us. Not many, but I'll take some.

quests.title: What the Water Carries
quests.description: Bring Windtalker Selva Brightpelt Bloodvenom Samples from the Seepage Oozes at Bloodvenom Falls.
quests.accept_text:
My spring's water comes down through the mountain from the north, and for three years the Moonglade side was shut and the water tasted of Felwood. It still does. Something from the Bloodvenom is getting into it.

The oozes at Bloodvenom Falls are made of that water. Bring me what's inside them, sealed, and I'll find out what it is. The falls are down the tunnel to North Felwood and a long way south, past Talonbranch Glade.
quests.turn_in_text:
Warm, and it moves. That isn't water any more.

I'll set a jar of it beside the spring and watch which way it pulls. If it's pulling toward the mountain, we'll need to dam the seep before it reaches the Hold's own wells.

quests.title: Bears at the Mouth
quests.description: Kill the Fel-Rotted Bears of North Felwood that come to the tunnel mouth for Honeykeeper Tova.
quests.accept_text:
The honey comes down from the Hold's hives in these crates, and every bear in Felwood can smell it from the tunnel mouth. The healthy ones give up. The fel-rotted ones don't, and two of them came up the hill last week and took a crate and half of Bramblecoat's coat.

Go down the tunnel to North Felwood and thin out the rotted bears. They wander all over the valley, so you won't have to look hard.
quests.turn_in_text:
Bramblecoat says the hill's quiet. He's growing his coat back, and he's not happy about the bald patch.

Take something sweet for the road. You've earned the first pick of the crates.

quests.title: Seeds of the Fel
quests.description: Take Fel-Tainted Seed Pouches from the Deadwood Gardeners and kill the Deadwood Pathfinders of Felpaw Village for Pathfinder Grosk.
quests.accept_text:
The Deadwood have started planting. They never planted anything before the newcomers came through, and now I watch their gardeners from the ridge above Felpaw, going out with full pouches and coming back with empty ones. Whatever they're planting, it isn't food.

Bring me their seed pouches before any more go in the ground, and put down their pathfinders while you're at it, because they're the ones who show the gardeners where to dig. Felpaw Village is down the tunnel to North Felwood and south-east.
quests.turn_in_text:
Look at these. Green right through, every seed. Selva will want to burn them at the spring.

I'll go back to the ridge tomorrow and see whether they've got any left. I hope they haven't.

quests.title: Deadwood Headdress Feathers
quests.description: Bring Featherkeeper Imna a handful of Deadwood Headdress Feathers from the Deadwood of Felpaw Village.
quests.accept_text:
Every Deadwood wears a headdress, and every headdress has Timbermaw feathers in it, from when they still knew who they were. I burn them in the waystation's fire, so whatever's left of who they were comes home.

Bring me a handful whenever you have them, as often as you like. The Deadwood are in Felpaw Village, down the tunnel to North Felwood and south-east.
quests.turn_in_text:
That's a handful come home. I'll burn them tonight, and the Elders will hear about who brought them.

Bring me more when you've got them.
